entry.title: New: Bill 82, CD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 4405, GRANTING HOʻOKAHI PALAMA ALIʻI, LLC A CONDITIONAL PERMIT TO CONDUCT LIMITED SPECIAL EVENTS, HISTORICAL AND BOTANICAL TOURS, PHOTO SHOOTS, WORKSHOPS, RETREATS, AND WELLNESS AND EXERCISE CLASSES, AND TO ALLOW A BRIDAL LOUNGE AND EVENT PREPARATION SPACE WITHIN THE COUNTY AGRICULTURAL DISTRICT, FOR PROPERTY SITUATED AT 250 HAIKU ROAD, HAIKU, MAUI, HAWAII" The purpose of this bill is to grant a five-year Conditional Permit time extension by amending Ordinance 4405 (2017) for Hoʻokahi Palama Aliʻi, LLC to continue operating special events in the County Agricultural District, located at 250 Haiku Road, Haʻikū, Maui, Hawaiʻi.
